run_visualize_attention: run the script to visualize ViT self-attention maps for a given image using DINO pretrained weights
run_attention_with_threshold: run the script with a threshold argument to generate segmented masks from attention maps
run_attention_custom_weights: run the script with custom pretrained weights and checkpoint key to visualize attention
display_instances_function: display masked image instances with colored contours and optional blur on a given mask
apply_mask_function: apply a colored mask overlay onto an image with configurable alpha transparency
